label: Glance Clock - progress ring
info:
Turns any 0-100 sensor into an arc on the outer ring, with a dim track
behind it so an empty ring still reads as a ring.

Change the entity id in the trigger node and the SENSOR constant in the
function node. The inject node is there so you can redraw without waiting
for the sensor to change.

The arc is 48 pixels for 100%, because each ring has 48 LEDs. Pixel 0 is at
twelve o'clock and numbering runs clockwise, so the arc grows the way a
clock hand moves.
